attributes.description: Fogo de Chão offers authentic Brazilian culture and cuisine in the heart of Downtown Pittsburgh.

text:
Authentic Brazilian Steakhouse Experience in Pittsburgh

Located at the corner of Smithfield and Oliver, Fogo de Chão offers authentic Brazilian culture and cuisine in the heart of Downtown Pittsburgh. Upon entering, guests have a panoramic view of the restaurant, featuring an open kitchen with the churrasqueira grill, a White Carrara marble Market Table, and an expansive bar. The warm, contemporary dining room welcomes guests with Brazilian-inspired design elements including a hand-woven rope wall and a bas-relief interpretation of Antônio Caringi’s famous statue, O Laçador, an embodiment of the gaucho culture of Southern Brazil.

Parking

Complimentary parking is available for up to 3 hours with validation at the 350 Oliver Avenue Garage, located above the restaurant at Oliver Avenue and Smithfield Street.

Bar Fogo Features

Join us for Bar Fogo Features Mon-Thurs at Bar Fogo, featuring $6 Beers, $8 South American Wines and $10 Brazilian-Inspired Cocktails.

Step into the extraordinary world of Tako, located in downtown Pittsburgh, where the flavors of Mexico and Japan unite in a mesmerizing fusion of street food delights. Our innovative restaurant presents a truly unparalleled blend of both cuisines, crafting a menu that tantalizes taste buds and leaves patrons in awe of its boundless creativity.
But Tako is more than just a culinary adventure; it’s a haven for tequila and mezcal enthusiasts. With an unmatched selection sourced locally for the highest quality, our knowledgeable staff is eager to guide both aficionados and newcomers through our impressive collection, elevating your dining experience to extraordinary heights.
At Tako, our dedication to sourcing the freshest, finest local ingredients reflects a genuine commitment to sustainability and support for local farmers and producers. This conscious approach to dining adds an extra layer of appreciation for the exceptional culinary journey that awaits you with each visit.
In essence, Tako transcends the definition of a mere restaurant; it’s an immersive experience celebrating the seamless convergence of two diverse yet harmonious culinary worlds. Prepare yourself for a remarkable taste adventure, where the brilliance of Tako’s chefs shines through, and the soulful marriage of Mexican and Japanese influences takes center stage. For an unforgettable dining escapade that promises to linger in your memory, Tako is the name you’ll fondly remember.

Iconic Dining in Pittsburgh

Housed in the beautifully preserved Pittsburgh & Lake Erie Railroad Station, the Grand Concourse Restaurant at Station Square is a true testament of grandeur and elegant dining. With cathedral stained-glass vaulted ceilings, marble columns, and a dramatic staircase, guests are quickly transported to the glamorous side of the Progressive Era, with the luxury of a modern-day menu. Our award-winning menu boasts a fine selection of signature seafood specialties, tender steaks, poultry, and on Sundays, the best brunch in Pittsburgh

View Menus

Our Story

The majestic Pittsburgh & Lake Erie Railroad Station was built in 1901. This 80,000 square foot historical landmark, which incorporated Victorian and Edwardian styles, was a major hub for transportation and travel in the Eastern United States. In 1974, this splendid facility was listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
In 1978, the late restauranteur Chuck Muer renovated the space and aptly named his new endeavor Grand Concourse. More than four decades later, the former train station turned Pittsburgh seafood restaurant still offers visitors an exquisite meal, as well as a historical perspective to the railroad era. Come see why diners all over Pennsylvania choose us time and time again.

We’re proud to share that Grand Concourse has been honored with the 2024 Diners' Choice Award for our unmatched Scenic Views to being the Most Booked restaurant. Our guests have spoken on their experiences, and we couldn't be more grateful! We are proud to be your go-to destination for a dining experience with unforgettable views and exceptional service. Come see what makes our restaurant an award winner!

Awards

At Grand Concourse, we take pride in our accomplishments and achievements. We believe that our wide number of awards and sterling ratings are a reflection of the hard work put in by every member of our staff since the day we first opened our doors. Some of our most consistently awarded honors included:
Best Brunch in Pittsburgh by Pittsburgh Magazine
Open Table Diner's Choice Award for Best Ambiance
Trip Advisor Certificate of Excellence Recipient
Best Breakfast at Savour Pittsburgh

Private Dining

The Grand Concourse is the ideal venue for weddings and private events. For decades, couples have made their entrance or said “I Do” on our Grand Staircase underneath stained glass windows surrounded by breathtaking architecture.
Our clients are offered a personal event concierge, customizable menus, A/V technology assistance, valet, and onsite parking options.
